issue_context.title: Long channel names move service name off the screen
issue_context.body: ### Checklist - [x] I am using the latest version - 0.20.3 - [x] I checked, but didn't find any duplicates (open OR closed) of this issue in the repo. - [x] I have read the contribution guidelines given at https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/blob/HEAD/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md. - [x] This issue contains only one bug. I will open one issue for every bug report I want to file. ### Steps to reproduce the bug 1. Bookmark [the playlist example](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=FLoXvuW2IhFawuNyk4yL3EkQ) 2. Go to 'Bookmarked Playlists' 3. See the service name off the screen ### Actual behaviour Long channel names move service name off the screen. ### Expected behavior Service name should stay on the screen even with long channel name. ### Screenshots/Screen recordings I propose to move service name to another string, something like this: ### Logs ### Device info - Android version/Custom ROM version: 10
comments: I'd just put three points in the middle instead, so that we don't have to shorten long titles (which are more important than channels)

It's a good reason because we have only 4 services for now (YouTube etc.) But I think that my decision is more perspective in the future when there will be dozens of them.
Yes, playlist names will be shortened with one string in portrait orientation, but it would not be real inconvenience. First 30-40 symbols should be enough for clarification, and I have a doubt that many people have playlist library with same of them exactly. And full playlist name may be known by long pressing on it (or even just turning phone around).

Hi everyone.
Can i fix this issue?

The PR was closed.

Possible solution from https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/pull/6287#issuecomment-856604658:
> This has to be fixed by changing the layout and setting `ellipsize`, not by truncating the string with code.
@ANUKULJHA1506 Are you working on this or any other PR? It's okay if it takes time, but please make sure to let us know if you've decided not to do it.
I think this assignment should be removed as there is no response from assigned developer for a year. So that other interested developer can take up this issue.

review_comments: If I'm not mistaken, this will always show the ellipsis, which is definitely not something that we want.
